videos.title: The Devil Don't Day Care | Short Horror Comedy 2026
videos.description:
Four employees are trapped inside a children's daycare due to paranormal "demonic" activity. Shirley nothing bad will happen... Right?

                                              Day
                                                ^
It looks like the Devil Don't     Care.

A NOTE FROM THE FILMMAKERS (Nick & Jacob):

It was never our intention to create a film that alludes to or makes light of real-life tragedies involving violence in schools and the safety of children.

We recognize that the subject matter and setting of this film may stir up emotions for some viewers. We understand that these are very real issues affecting families and communities, and we want to be clear that this film was created purely for entertainment.

Horror is supposed to scare you. 
Reality shouldn't have to.

IF YOU DON'T ENJOY OUR FILM, that's okay! Maybe consider putting that energy toward something that can actually make a difference.

In recognition of the importance of protecting children and keeping our schools and communities safe, we encourage you to support organizations working to prevent gun violence and protect the next generation.

Here are a few places where you can make a difference:

Sandy Hook Promise:
https://www.sandyhookpromise.org/get-involved/ways-to-give/

You don't have to donate to every organization, but even taking the time to learn, share resources, and or getting involved can make a difference.

Thank you for watching, supporting independent filmmaking, and helping make the world a safer place.

Please enjoy our movie.

videos.title: Headstone A Cinematic Sonnet
videos.description:
I was tasked with creating a cinematic sonnet for a TV class back in 2023... I just decided to reuse and recycle my old short poem "Headstones" and turned it into this.

My wish, I wish to say that my time is limited in which I have no doubt. I look at the scars in my bones and the stories they tell me. I'm reminded of my "Golden Path" but I'm not guided to it. For just a moment, I invite myself to walk off to find the void of my restless dreams in which no seeds shall become secure and no win go remembered. I love myself and I love this void, and for however far I move forward, the past will forever rattle inside of me. I would burn a star just to say goodbye.

videos.title: My First Time - Short Comedy
videos.description:
This short film is 3 years late haha

We made this back during The Living Reanimator. So... Just about over three years.

We produced this whole script and Idea in under 24 hours so... That's pretty cool.

There's a lot to be said about this project, I wish I had the words. I will continue to study and memorize the constellations to try and find my way home.

videos.title: That one time in class
videos.description:
I've been in College since 2019 and I'm now only half way through lol 
(Congrats to my friends who graduated)

My process has been this... Work on film full time and go to film school part time. Make sure you bring in enough cash for rice, turnkey and rent and nothing can stop you. I've had some ups and downs but it's so far been successful. I mean... Film School is kind of a joke if you're not working too but that's just my opinion based on my 6 years of being in college. I feel like stretching out my education for as long as possible will bring me more success through networking and crafting my skills than will running through everything as quickly as possible to get some meaningless paper that says "You can do it!" I'll get my degree eventually, I'm just saying that my work will speak for itself.

If we keep going, we'll get better. When we get better, we'll be producing great movies/ Stories.
Get good enough at it that someone will hire your for it. Or build a community that lifts each other up.
Best world is where it's all happening.

I've got some good stuff coming out soon so... Like and Subscribe if you wanna see more 🃏

videos.title: Reaper Teaser Trailer
videos.description:
A young witch casts a dark forest spell that's able to bring back her lost husband using a flower in an attempt to love him once again.

Check out our official Kickstarter!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jesterfollyfilms/reaper-1?ref=creator-nav   

The idea for this story first began when listening to the song 'Like Real People Do'  by Hozier. The lyrics painted a picture in my mind. That of a woman unearthing a man. This image pestered me and blossomed into so much more. This story dissects grief and power. It begs the question would you take the chance to love someone again, if it meant you had to lose them too? This film's narrative and visual presentation juxtaposes whimsical and chilling. Our goal from the beginning was to play with the nature of human curiosity towards magick.  One moment Violet is a sorceress, the next an innocent widow. Can we trust her? Can you? -Chrissy

videos.title: The Living Reanimator!
videos.description:
A young mother is brutally murdered by a mad scietist, who turns her into a in a twisted experiment using a secret serum meant to ressurect the dead. Unable to control his walking corpse, the entire science facility is shut down by a secret military organization, tasked with making sure this labs walking biohazard can never escape into society. Little do they know that for every corpse they make, The Living Reanimator will take.


For my Film 1 Final, I was tasked with telling a thematic story without using any more than 5 words in under about 5 mins. Let me know how I did in the comments :) Also, Merry Christmas

videos.description:
TLOU-
Directed by Jacob Kelly
Written by @rock_music_nerd7 
Cinematography by @breezyday57 

Cast
The Last - Sarah
The Third - @tarra.k.f 
The first - Breezy
The Second - Jacob
-
Song- What Hurts the Most by State of Mine
-
Description:
If you ever decide to look back at some of my projects from High School, then you would see a video called "The Fatal Spread". I have two versions of that movie that were really just experiments with editing softwares; In them the ground shakes to the beat and everything's keyed over. To be honest, I was just testing out Final Cut Pro for the first time and wanted to see what it could do. After that first video, my cousins wanted to make a prequel music video for fun and we did, we shot some of the video but it went nowhere. I kept the footage on a hard drive for years while I worked on Stuck in Your Head and The Hunchback of Bartonsville, I got super busy with life so it was hard to do personal projects.
After making my first film, I got a job at ApertureAlly, which was probably one of the greatest experiences of my life. I learned how to really edit, specifically weddings which showed me a complex variety of editing challenges. Imagine having to make a 3:00 minute wedding Highlight with only 30 clips and a Feature that's less than 32 mins long, shot by somebody else. I had to get creative. 
When I tried editing TLOU, I realized I didn't have a full song with the clips we had, only half of the new video was shot. So I re-edited "Fatal Spread" and turned the entire project into something combines that's now super special to me. These videos were shot years ago and I've come a long way in my film education since initially filming them. I'd like to also mention that the only reason I actually finished it was because it was Breezy's birthday.

videos.title: Stuck in Your Head Directors Commentary
videos.description:
Welcome to The Directors Commentary of Stuck in Your Head! Watch and listen as Director Jacob Kelly and Star Nina Maxwell break down and discuss what it was like working on the film while diving deep into production secrets and what it was to be apart of the crew. Enjoy as the two commentate over their movie one year after it's initial production began!

Stuck in your Head is an Action Comedy Directed by Jacob Kelly following Alex White. A teenage girl with average teenage girl problems, except that she can read the minds of the people who touch her. Because of these powers, Alex has attracted some unwanted attention from a powerful agency that has set out to uncover the truth. This agency has sent in two highly trained very skilled operatives; Steve Wilson and Ben Dover. Follow Alex as she discovers everything about herself, her friends, and her powers.

If you enjoy, consider leaving a like and subscribing!
